caveats: Experimental beta for Paseo 0.9.0-beta.1+; 0.9.2 checked offline, 0.12.0-beta.2 live. Block and inline math in completed replies; the latest reply stays native after a page reload.
macOS host and browser components checked; native mobile UI and sustained multi-client load are untested.

Use the Math native-reply Command Center action before chat Find; rendered rows lack host search integration.

Avoid enabling another assistant-message replacement plugin for the same content.
